Turns any input (code, docs, papers, images, videos) into a persistent knowledge graph with god nodes, community detection, and query/path/explain tools.
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".

Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". ## Memo Derived Metadata: Complete Analysis

This repository is **usememos/memos**, a self-hosted note-taking application. Memo derived metadata is computed in two distinct categories: (1) **stored payload metadata** (tags, properties) computed at write time and persisted to the database, and (2) **on-the-fly metadata** (snippet, converted properties for the API response) computed at read time when serving API responses.

---

### 1. Core Data Structures

**Store-layer Memo model** -- `/bench/home/work/store/memo.go` (lines 36-55)
- The `Memo` struct holds `Payload *storepb.MemoPayload` which contains all persisted derived metadata.

**Protobuf definition of the stored payload** -- `/bench/home/work/proto/store/memo.proto` (lines 7-29)
- `MemoPayload` contains:
  - `Property property` (the computed content properties)
  - `Location location`
  - `repeated string tags`
- `Property` sub-message (lines 16-21) has:
  - `has_link` (bool) -- whether the content contains markdown links
  - `has_task_list` (bool) -- whether the content has GFM task list items
  - `has_code` (bool) -- whether the content has code blocks or inline code
  - `has_incomplete_tasks` (bool) -- whether any task checkboxes are unchecked
  - `title` (string) -- extracted from the first H1 heading, if present

**API-level Memo message** -- `/bench/home/work/proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` (lines 198-280)
- Exposes `OUTPUT_ONLY` derived fields to clients:
  - `repeated string tags` (line 241) -- extracted from content
  - `Property property` (line 256) -- computed properties
  - `string snippet` (line 266) -- plain-text snippet of the memo content, max 64 characters

---

### 2. The Central Computation: `RebuildMemoPayload`

**File:** `/bench/home/work/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` (lines 74-88)

This is the single function that computes and attaches derived metadata to a memo. It:
1. Calls `markdownService.ExtractAll(memo.Content)` -- a single-pass AST walk
2. Sets `memo.Payload.Tags` from the extracted tags
3. Sets `memo.Payload.Property` from the extracted property (has_link, has_task_list, has_code, has_incomplete_tasks, title)

**When it runs:**
- **On memo creation:** `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` line 108
- **On memo content update:** `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` line 447
- **Batch rebuild on demand:** The `Runner.RunOnce()` method (lines 27-72 in `runner.go`) iterates all memos in batches of 100 and rebuilds every payload, used for migrations/data repairs

---

### 3. The Markdown Service: Extraction and Snippet Generation

**File:** `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/markdown.go`

This is the `markdown.Service` interface (lines 31-55) and its goldmark-based implementation. Key methods:

**`ExtractAll` (lines 356-422)** -- The most efficient extraction method, doing a single AST walk to collect:
- **Tags:** All `#tag` nodes (excluding those inside links/images)
- **Mentions:** All `@mention` nodes (lowercased)
- **Property:** Boolean flags (`HasLink`, `HasCode`, `HasTaskList`, `HasIncompleteTasks`) and `Title` (from first H1)

**`ExtractProperties` (lines 193-241)** -- Standalone property extraction via AST walk. Computes the same boolean flags and title as `ExtractAll` but without tags/mentions.

**`ExtractTags` (lines 143-170)** -- Standalone tag extraction.

**`GenerateSnippet` (lines 264-346)** -- Creates a plain-text summary:
- Parses markdown to AST, walks it collecting text content
- Strips code blocks (keeps inline code spans)
- Adds spaces between block elements (paragraphs, headings, list items, table cells)
- Preserves tag markers (`#tag`)
- Truncates at word boundary using `truncateAtWord()` (lines 472-489), which handles multi-byte UTF-8 characters correctly
- Called with `maxLength=64` for API responses

**Service initialization:** `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/v1.go` (lines 48-51) -- creates the service with tag and mention extensions enabled.

---

### 4. Snippet Computation at Read Time

**File:** `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` (lines 83-90)

`getMemoContentSnippet(content string)` -- wrapper that calls `s.MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet(content, 64)`. This is **not** persisted; it is computed on every API response.

**Where snippets are attached to API responses:**

- **Single memo conversion:** `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go` lines 76-80 -- `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators` calls `getMemoContentSnippet` and sets `memoMessage.Snippet`
- **Batch relation snippets:** Same file, lines 221-273 -- `batchConvertMemoRelations` computes snippets for memo relations (both the source and related memos in `MemoRelation.Memo.Snippet`)
- **Notification snippets:** `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go` lines 318-391 -- `memoNotificationSnippet` generates snippets for inbox notification payloads (comment and mention notifications)
- **Relation service:** `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go` lines 154-173 -- snippets for individual relation responses

---

### 5. Property Conversion (Store to API)

**File:** `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go` (lines 315-326)

`convertMemoPropertyFromStore` maps the stored `MemoPayload_Property` to the API's `Memo_Property`:
- `HasLink`, `HasTaskList`, `HasCode`, `HasIncompleteTasks`, `Title`

This is called within `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators` (line 49).

---

### 6. Property/Tag Usage in Stats

**File:** `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go`

Both `GetUserStats` (lines 193-296) and `ListAllUserStats` (lines 56-191) iterate through memos and aggregate their derived payload data:
- Tag counts from `memo.Payload.Tags`
- Type stats (link/code/todo/undo counts) from `memo.Payload.Property`

---

### 7. Frontend Usage of Derived Metadata

The frontend consumes all derived metadata from the API response (it does **not** recompute it):

- **Snippet display in lists:** `/bench/home/work/web/src/components/MemoView/components/MemoSnippetLink.tsx` -- renders snippet text with fallback
- **Snippet in map view:** `/bench/home/work/web/src/components/UserMemoMap/UserMemoMap.tsx` line 154
- **Snippet in comment previews:** `/bench/home/work/web/src/components/MemoView/components/MemoCommentListView.tsx` line 45
- **Snippet in relation sidebar:** `/bench/home/work/web/src/components/MemoDetailSidebar/MemoDetailSidebar.tsx` lines 91-105, 155
- **Property-based filtering:** `/bench/home/work/web/src/hooks/useMemoFilters.ts` lines 73-77 -- maps `property.hasLink`, `property.hasTaskList`, `property.hasCode` filter factors to CEL filter expressions
- **Tag display/filtering:** `/bench/home/work/web/src/hooks/useFilteredMemoStats.ts` -- aggregates tag counts from user stats
- **MemoPreview component:** `/bench/home/work/web/src/components/MemoPreview/MemoPreview.tsx` -- renders a read-only preview of memo content for relation cards and other contexts
- **Card height estimation:** `/bench/home/work/web/src/components/PagedMemoList/memoCardHeight.ts` -- uses memo content/attachments/relations to estimate card heights for virtualized rendering

---

### Summary of the Data Flow

```
Memo Content (Markdown string)
       |
       | [On Create/Update]
       v
RebuildMemoPayload() -----> markdownService.ExtractAll()
       |                          |
       |                     Single AST walk extracts:
       |                       - Tags (#tag nodes)
       |                       - Property (has_link, has_code, has_task_list,
       |                                   has_incomplete_tasks, title)
       |                       - Mentions (@user nodes)
       v
  Stored in DB as memo.Payload (MemoPayload protobuf)
       |
       | [On Read/API Response]
       v
convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators()
       |
       |-- Tags: copied from payload
       |-- Property: converted via convertMemoPropertyFromStore()
       |-- Snippet: computed on-the-fly via getMemoContentSnippet()
       |            -> markdownService.GenerateSnippet(content, 64)
       v
  API Memo message with all derived OUTPUT_ONLY fields
```

The key distinction is that **tags and property are persisted** (computed at write time via `RebuildMemoPayload`), while **snippet is ephemeral** (computed at read time via `GenerateSnippet`).

**Computation site:** `RebuildMemoPayload` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-88`, which calls `markdownService.ExtractAll()` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:356-422`) — a single-pass goldmark AST walk over the memo's markdown content. Additionally, the `snippet` is computed on-the-fly at read time via `getMemoContentSnippet` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83-90`), which calls `markdownService.GenerateSnippet(content, 64)`.

**Triggers:** (1) Memo creation (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`), (2) memo content update (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`), and (3) batch rebuild of all memos via `Runner.RunOnce()` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27-72`). The snippet is recomputed on every API read (in `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators` at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:76`).

**Extracted properties** (persisted in `MemoPayload`, defined in `proto/store/memo.proto:15-22`):
- **`tags`** — all `#tag` nodes found in the content (deduplicated, case-preserved)
- **`has_link`** — whether the content contains markdown links
- **`has_task_list`** — whether the content has GFM task checkboxes
- **`has_code`** — whether the content has code blocks, fenced code blocks, or code spans
- **`has_incomplete_tasks`** — whether any task checkbox is unchecked
- **`title`** — text of the first H1 heading, if the first block-level element is one
- **`snippet`** (ephemeral, not persisted) — a plain-text summary truncated to 64 characters at a word boundary, generated from the AST with code blocks stripped
